title: The Little Growing Garden
synopsis: All five friends revisit the garden, notice two sunflower shoots and a still-bare space, draw a picture of the little garden as it exists now, and store it at Story House.
continuity_state: Before: Kim knows of the planted garden, Todd has sketched three radish seedlings, Wendy has seen one sunflower shoot and paper hat props are indoors. Existing books/maps/envelope/lantern in their season-four locations. After: All five friends and trusted adults see multiple radish leaves and two sunflower shoots; one planted patch still bare, no flowers or harvested radishes. Friends draw a paper card showing present garden (plus silly details), placed in new plain LITTLE GROWING GARDEN folder on Story House low shelf beside blue sound book and brown Button Town envelope. Amy adds two green marks inside real map garden square. Small garden sign and stepping stones remain outdoors. All friends return home with adults; season resolved without a pending event.

related_resources.reason: Extension guidance explains germination varies with seed quality and growing conditions; not every planted seed produces a seedling.
